text.body: śrīgāyatrīprasādena yatkiñcit procyate mayāḥ| gumassaṃgṛhyatām tasmād guṇadorṣāvavekibhiḥ|| 1 || dṛśyamānasya lokasya pradhānam kāraṇam matam| kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogaḥ prokto'yam sāṃkhyadarśane|| 2 || sāṃkhyadarśane proktaḥ ayam kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogaḥ dṛśyamānasya lokasya pradhānam kāraṇam matam| paṅgvavadubhayorapi saṃyogastatkṛtaḥ sargaḥ ītīdam sāṃkhyakārikāvākyamatra pramāṇam| prakṛteḥ kṣetrasaṃjñā syāt pumān kṣetrajña ucyate| prakṛtyā tasya saṃyogāl‌loko'yam sujyate sadā|| 3 || sāmyāvasthā guṇānām yā prakṛtissā khalūcyate| sattvaṃrajastamāṃsyete kāryato hi guṇāstrayaḥ|| 4 || sattvaṃ rajaḥ, tama iti trayo guṇāḥ| teṣām sāmyāvasthaiva prakṛtirityucyate| sattvarajastamasām sāmyāvasthā prakṛtiriti vācaspatimiśrāḥ | buddhistatprathamā sṛṣṭirdvitīyā syādahaṅkṛtiḥ| ahaṅkārasamutpannaṃ tanmātraṃ bhūtakāraṇam|| 5 || prakṛteḥ prathamā sṛṣṭirmahaditi kathitā buddhiḥ| dvitīyā sṛṣṭirahaṅkāraḥ| asmādevāhaṅkarāt bhūtānam kāraṇāni tanmātāṇi samutpannāni| indriyāṇi daśaikañca vikāro'haṅkṛtestathā| pradhāno yo guṇastisminnahaṅkāre sa tatparaḥ|| 6 || pradhānam vaikṛte sattvam taijase raja ucyate| tamastu tāmase mukhyaṃ saṃjñā jñeyā hi kāryataḥ || 7 || ekādeśendriyāṇi cāhaṅkurasyaiva vikāraḥ| tathāhi yo guṇaḥ ahaṅkāre pradhānaḥ sa ahaṅkāraḥ tatpara eva bhavati| vaikṛtāhaṅkāre sattvaguṇaḥ, taijasāhaṅkāre rajoguṇaḥ, tāmasāhaṅkāre ca tamogumaśca pradhānāḥ| evam kāryāta eva saṃjñā jñātavyā| jñānendriyāṇi pañcaiva karmendriyāṇi pañca ca| ahaṅkārasya kāryam tanmanāsaṃ cāntarindriyam|| 8 || cakṣuḥ, śrotraṃ, jihrā, ghrāṇam tvak - ityetāni jñānendriyāṇi pañca| evam vāk, pāṇiḥ pādaḥ, pāyuḥ, upasthaḥ - ityetāni pañca karmendriyāṇi| manaścāntarindriyam| itthamekādaśendriyāṇi taijasāhaṅkārasahakṛtasāttvikāhaṅkārāt samutpadyante| pañcaviṃśatitamā sāṃkhyakārikā gauḍapādabhāṣyasahitā draṣṭavyā| ahaṅkāro mahat cittam manaścatvāri darśane| antaḥ kāraṇamityekam labhante nāma kāryataḥ ||9|| ekamevāntaḥ karaṇam vṛttibhedāt - ahaṅkāro, mahat, cittaṃ, mana - iti darśane kathyate yogadarśane tu vṛttibhedāt traividhyaṃ mahadahaṅkāramanaḥ svarūpameva prasiddham| na tu cāturvidhyam| cittasya cātra mate mahita bud‌dhyaparapāryaye praveśa iti vijñānabhikṣuvākyamātra draṣṭavyam| vaividhyam dṛśyate kārye caikattvam karaṇe tathā| kāryaṃ sarvaṃ viniṣpannaṃ kāraṇādeva tattvataḥ|| 10 || pradhānasya hi kāryattvāt manastraiguṇyamīryate| guṇānāmmānase tasmāt vṛttyākhyaṃ karma dṛśyate || 11|| triguṇātmakāt pradhānānniṣpannam mano'pi triguṇātmakaṃ mano'pi truguṇātmakam bhavati| kāraṇaguṇāḥ kāryaguṇānārabhanta iti nyāyaḥ| ata eva manasi guṇānām vṛttyākhyam karma dṛśyate| yayedam dhāryate cittaṃ tatsattvaṃ jñāyate yayā| jñeyā sā cittavṛttistu sarvā brāhmaṇavṛttivat|| 12 || `yaiḥ pramāṇādilakṣaṇavyāpāraiḥ cittaṃ jīvati te tad‌vṛttaya ucyante dvijānāṃ yājanādivat|' iti vijñānabhikṣuṇoktaṃ vākyamatra pramāṇam vṛttyaiva cittvasattvaṃ ityatra jñeyam| ata eva vṛttiṣu gṛhītāsu cittamapi nigṛhyate| asaṃkhyeyā hi cittasya vṛttayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ| ekatra gaṇane pañca vṛttayaḥ śaktisaṃjñakāḥ || 13|| pramāṇaṃ prathamā vṛttirdvitīyā tu viparyayaḥ| vikalpākhyā tṛtīyā syānnidrā'nyā smṛtipañcamī ||14|| yathārthānubhavaḥ śāstre prameti kathyate budhaiḥ | pramāyāśca pramāṇaṃ tat karaṇam śāstrakīrtitam || 15|| pratyakṣamanumānañca śabdastattvavinirṇaye| trayametatpramāṇaṃ syāt sarvaṃ tenaiva sādhyate || 16 || yuktābhyāmindriyārthābhyāṃ jāyamānaḥ pramā grahaḥ | pratyakṣaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ syādanumānasya kāraṇam ||17|| ‘prameyasiddhiḥ pramāṇāddhi’ iti nyāyamanusṛtya yogadarśane pramāṇatrayamaṅgīkriyate| pratyakṣaṃ anumānaṃ, śabdaḥ iti pramāṇatrayema yogadarśane tattvanirṇaye sarvaṃ sādhyate| indriyaṃ yadā viṣayeṇa saha saṃbaddhaṃ bhavati tadā jāyamānaṃ jñānaṃ tatkaraṇamapi pratyakṣam| anumānamapi pratyakṣamevādhārīkṛtya pravartate| vartamānena sambandhād‌vṛttavartiṣyamāṇayoḥ| jñānaṃ yajjāyate tatra hyanumānaṃ pramākaram|| 18 || liṅgād‌vyāptimato jñānaṃ liṅgino jāyate yadā| pramā sā'numitisttra hyanumānaṃ ca kāraṇam || niyatasāhacaryakāt liṅgāt yadā liṅgano jñānaṃ jāyate tatra `anumitiṛ' pramā ‘anumānaṃ’ pramāṇam| yathārthadarśino vākyaṃ niściyātmakam| vedāḥ vṛddhāśca vijñeyāḥ pramāṇaṃ tattvanirṇaye || 19 || atadrūpapratiṣṭaṃ yajjñānaṃ satyatvavarjitam| avidyākhyaṃ bhaved‌yoge saṃjñā tasya viparyayaḥ || 20 || jñānasvarupe apratiṣṭhaṃ mithyātvagarbhitam jñānam yoge viparyaya iti kathyate avidyāparaparyāyaḥ| vṛttiryā vastuśūnyattve śabdajñānānupātinī| vikalpa iti vikhyātā jñeyā sā yogadarśane || 21 || jāgrad‌vṛttistathā vṛttiḥ svāpnitakī tamasā yadā| abhibhūte bhavetāṃ sā vṛttirnidrate kathyate || 22 || abhāvaścānyavṛttīnāṃ tāmaso jāyate tadā| malinā cittasattvasya vṛttirnidreti kīrtitā || 23 || nidrāyā vṛttirūpattvaṃ smaraṇādeva budhyate| jāgṛtau yādṛśī dṛṣṭā smṛtirnidrā ca tādṛśī || 24 || vinā vṛttiṃ kathaṃ jñānam jñānābhāve katham smṛtiḥ| tasmānnidrā bhaved‌vṛtti smṛtyāssattvāddhi jāgṛtau || 25 || jāgt‌ svapnavṛttī yadā tamasā mohakāriṇā'bhibhūyete, vṛttyantarāṇām tāmase'bhāve jāte tadā cittasya sad‌vṛttirupiṇī malinā vṛttiḥ `nidrā' iti kathyate| jāgradavasthāyāṃ nidrāyā anantaraṃ yādṛśī smṛtiḥ jāyate nidrā tādṛśīti jñātavyā| smṛtiranubhavādhīnā, anubhavaśca vṛttayadīnaḥ| ataḥ nitrā cittavṛttiḥ| gṛhītagrāhiṇī vṛttiścittasya smṛtirucyate| ūnā syādanubhūtesmā nādhikā tu kadācana|| 26 || yā cittavṛttiḥ gṛhītameva viṣayaṃ gṛh‌ṇāti sā ‘smṛti’ riti kathyate| anubhave yāvān viṣayaḥ tasmādanadhika viṣayā vṛttirityarthaḥ. yāvantaṃ viṣayamanubhavāmaḥ, tāvantaṃ, tannyūnaṃ vā smarāmaḥ na tu tadadhikam| gṛhītagrahiṇītyukte doṣassyāllakṣaṇe tathā| jñāne cānugatākāre h‌yativyāptiḥ prasajyate || 27 || ativyāptirna vā tasmin lakṣaṇe bhinnarūpataḥ| jñāne cānugatākāre tadūno viṣayo na hi || 28 || "ghaṭaḥ, ghaṭaḥ,ghaṭaḥ" ityekavastu viṣayakajñāne'pi gṛhītagrāhitvamastītī ‘ativyāptiprasaṅgaḥ’ | parantu jñāne cāsmin pūrvagṛhītaviṣayādūno viṣayo na bhavati| smṛtau tu viṣayaḥ `anubhavaviṣayādanadhikaviṣaya' ato na tatrāvyāptiriti yogasiddhāntacandrikā'trānusandheyā| vṛttibhissaha cittasya nirodho yoga ucyate| yogassmādhināmā'sau `rājayoga' itīryate || 30 || yogassmādhissamāpattirityanarthāntaram| dhyayamālambayāyaṃ samādhirdvidhā bhavati| samprajñātasamādhiḥ prathamaḥ, asamprajñātaśca dvitīyaḥ| yadā dhyeyam pravijñātam samādhau cittarodhataḥ| sambrajñātastadā jñeyassamādhissa caturvidhaḥ || 31 || savitarkavicārau dvau sānandasāsmitau tathā| samprajñātasya catvāro bhedā yogo prakīrtitāḥ || 32 || yasmin samādhau dhyeyaṃ vastu samyak vijñāyate sa samādhiḥ ‘samprajñāta’ iti kathyate| savitarkasamādhiḥ, savicārasamādhiḥ, sānandasamādhiḥ, sāsmitāsamādhiriti catvāro'sya bhedāḥ| cittasyālambanaṃ sthalaṃ vitarke pāñcabhautikam| savicāre tathā sūkṣmaṃ canmātraṃ bhūtakāraṇam || 33 || yadā cittaṃ pāñcabhautikaṃ sthūlamālambya sthūlamālambya bhavati tadā sa samādhiḥ `savitarka' nāmakaḥ| yadā ca sūkṣamaṃ tanmātrādikamālāmbate tadā `savicāra' nāmakaḥ| grāh‌yo'yaṃ viṣayo yoge prathamaścittanigrahe| sānandasāsmitau paścāt bhedau grahaṇapūrvakau || 34 || ekībhāvo yadā buddhergrahītrā puruṣeṇa ca| asmitā sa samādhissyāt puruṣo viṣayastadā || 35 || sattvaprakarṣahetostu sākṣātkāro hi jāyate| āh‌lādayasya yadā jñeyassānando hi tadā sphuṭaḥ || 36 || yadā buddhiḥ grahītrā puruṣeṇa sahaikībhāvamāpnoti sa samādhissamāsmitā nāmaḥ `ekātmikā saṃvidasmiteti' bhāṣyam| `asmi ityetāvanmātrākāratvādasmitā ityarthaḥ|' sattvaprakarṣaema jāyamānasya āh‌lādasya sākṣātkāraḥ `sānandaḥ' ayamānandaścittadharma eeti vyākhyātāraḥ| yadā tāḥ vṛttyassarvā virāmaṃ yānti sarvaśaḥ| saṃskāraśśiṣyate yoge cittasyānanyagāminaḥ || 37 || vairāgyaṃ hi paraṃ hetussamādheryasya vidyate| asamprajñātanāmā'sau samādhiḥ kāśate tadā || 38 || yato dhyeyārthaśūnyo'yaṃ vastuśanyattvamāśritaḥ| ato'smin dhyeyavairāgyaṃ samādhau kāraṇaṃ matam || 39 || sarvavṛttinirodhe yadā kevalassaṃkāraśśiṣyate tadā `asamprajñāta' samādhiḥ| aparavairāgyaṃ paravairāgyamiti vairāgyaṃ dvividham| tatra strayannapānādiṣu dṛṣṭeṣu svargādiṣu ca vaitṛṣṇyam prathamam| guṇasyāśeṣavyavahāreṣu tṛṣmavirodhastatassattvapuruṣayoḥ śuddhisāmye kaivalyam yogena yogo jñātavya ityuktaṃ yogillajaiḥ|| prathamena tathā cānyo jñeyo yogastathā śanaiḥ || 40 || samprajñātāyogena śanairasambaprajñātayogo jñātavya ityarthaḥ| upāyapratyayassādhyo yogaśśraddhādikāraṇaiḥ| mumukṣūṇāmayaṃ grāh‌yo viśeṣādrājayoginām || 41 || śraddhā, vīryaṃ, smṛtiḥ, samādhiḥ, prajñā - iti śraddhādikāraṇam| pūrvapūrvasya tadanantarajanakatayā kaivalyakāraṇatvam| janmamātrādasamprajñatrassamādhissulabho na hi| tasmād‌devamanuṣyāṇāṃ nūnaṃ śraddhādirāhitaḥ || 42|| bhavaheturvidehānāmaṣāṭ‌kauśikadehanām| prakṛtyāṃ līyamānānāṃ samādhissaiva kathyate || 43 || avidyaiva bhavasyāto jñeyā mithyātmikā hi sā| asya mūlaṃ yato'vidyā yogasyāto hi heyatā || 44 || asamprajñāto dvividhaḥ - upāyapratyayo bhavapratyayaśca| mumukṣūṇāmupāyapratyayaḥ pūrvoktaḥ dvitīyo bhavapratyayaḥ avidyāhetukaḥ videhānāṃ prakṛtilayānāñca| māṃsaśoṇitalomamedo'sthimajjārūpaṣāṭ‌kauśikadeharahitā videhāḥ piṇḍapādānantaraṃ bhūtendriyeṣu līnāḥ| avyaktamahadahaṅkārapañcatanmātrāṇāmanyatamamātmatvena pratipannāstadupāsanayā piṇḍapātānantaraṃ prakṛtyādikāraṇeṣu līnāḥ prakṛtilayāḥ| bhavapratyayāsamprajñātasamādheravidyā mūlamiti sa tyājyaḥ| samādhissukhasādhyo'yaṃ tīvrasaṃvegahetunā| upāyā vividhāssanti samādhessiddhādāyakāḥ || 45 || tīvravairāgyeṇa samādhissukhasādhyaḥ| yeṣāṭamupāyānuṣṭhānaśaighyraṃ teṣāmāsanna ssamādhilābhaḥ| `śradhdamūlo yoga' iti vācaspatimiśrairuktaṃ, `yo yacchraddhassa eva sa iti bhagavaduktaṃ ca śraddhāprādhānyaṃ pratipādayataḥ|' bhaktiyogaḥ kriyāyogaḥ caryāyogastathaiva ca| karmayogo haṭho mantro jñānayogo layastathā || 46 || advaitolakṣyayogaśca siddhirbrahmastathā śivaḥ| vāsanādhyānayogau ca sarve sūtreṣu darśitāḥ || 47 || pañcadaśayogaprakārāḥ pātañjalayogasūtrebhya eva jñātuṃ śakyā iti yogasiddhānta candrikākṛtaḥ nārāyaṇatīrthasvāminaḥ pratyapīdan| viśeṣastatra draṣṭavyaḥ| bhaktyāhīśaḥ prasannassanan mokṣaṃ śīghraṃ prayacchati| tasmādīśapraṇidhyānādantarāyā bhavanti na || 48 || kleśākarmavipākaiśca tathā saṃskārarupibhiḥ| na kadā'pi parāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣastvīśvaro mataḥ || 49 || sarvajñāssarvagassarvaṃ kālañcāpyativartate| kālasyāpi ca hetuttvādīśvaro nitya ucyate || 50 || prāṇavasya jāpannityaṃ tathā tasyārthabhāvanāt| ekāgraṃ jāyate cittaṃ paramātmā prakāśate || 51|| tasmādīśapraṇidhyānādantarāyā bhavanti na| svarupajñānamapyasya yoginassamprajāyate || 52 || antarāyāstu vikṣepāḥ jñātavyā vighnakārakāḥ| vikṣepohapataṃ cittaṃ jāyate tktabhāvanam || 53 || `vyādhistyānasaṃśayapramādālasyāviratibhrāntidarśanā'labdha bhūmikatvānavasthitatvāni cittavikṣepāḥ te'ntarāyāḥ iti yogasūtram duḥkhadaurmanasyāṅgamejayatvaśvāsapraśvāsā vikṣepasahabhuvaḥ' iti ca yogasūtramatra draṣṭavye| yathaiveśvaraśśuddhaḥ prasannaḥ kevalaḥ pumān| tathā buddhivisaṃvedī jīvo jātyādivarjitaḥ || 54 || ityevam jāyate buddhirjīvātmaparamātmanoḥ| svarūpajñānapūrṇā hi samādhisthasya yoginaḥ || 55 || vikṣepaistairyadā cittaṃ bādhate yiganaṃ tadā| abhyāsena ca saṃskārtuṃ prayateta sa saṃyamī || 56|| parasya sukhasāṃprāptau mitrattvaṃ bhāvayet sudhīḥ| kuraṇāṃ ca tathā duḥkhe puṇye harṣañca bhāvayet || 57 || apuṇye ca tathopekṣāṃ satataṃ bhāvayet budhaḥ| prasannaṃ labhate cittaṃ caryāyogo'yamucyate || 58 || pradhāno mārutaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇādhāro hi mānavaḥ| prāṇāyāmena cittasya nigrahassulabhassadā || 59 || prayatnāt kukṣito vāyuṃ nāsikāpuṭamārgātaḥ| śanairnissārayet samyak praśvāso'yaṃ nigadyate || 60 || recitasya bahirvāyoḥ sthāpanaṃ kumbhakaṃ matam| śvāsapraśvāsakumbhāśca haṭhayogo nigadyate || 61 || haṭhayogo yogabījaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ `sūryācindramasoraikyaṃ haṭha ityabhidhīyate' ityādismṛtivākyāni prāṇāyāmasya haṭhayogatvaṃ pratipādayantīti pramāṇam| gandhadirviṣayo yasyāṃ pravṛttiṃ samāśritaḥ| yogīcettasya cittaṃ hi bhavatyeva visaṃśayam || śabdādyāssaṃvidaśicittaṃ prukurvanti visaṃśayam| śraddhā saṃvardhate tena sakṣyayogena sattvikī || nāsāgrādau cittasya saṃyamarupāllakṣayayogāttattadviṣayasākṣātkāraḥ, tena śraddhā, tayā ca dhyānādau sthiraṃ cittaṃ bhavati| evaṃ pūrvoktasākṣātkāreṇa manasi saṃśayā dūrībhavanti| mānasasya sthitiṃ roddhuṃ cāsmitāmātranāmikā| pravṛttissā samarthā syāt buddhisaṃvedarupiṇī || 64 || brahmayogo viśoketi sūtre'smin kathitaḥ pade| jyotiṣṭamattyāḥ prasaṅgācca śivayogo'pi sūcitaḥ || 65 || viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī ityasmin yogasūtre manasaḥ sthitinibandhinī kācit pravṛttiruktā | āyāsakṛtakleśarahitā jyotirviṣayā ceyaṃ pravṛttirbrahmaśivayogau sūcayatīti yogasiddhāntacandrikā| athavā cittasaṃrodhe mānasaṃ tadvirāgiṇaḥ| ālambyate yadā cittaṃ tadā tenāpi rudhyate || 66 || vairāgyavato mānasamapi yogī cittasthairyamāpnoti| nirvāsanaṃ manassamāśrīyata iti yogo'yaṃ vāsanāyoga iti kathyate| svapne prabuddharūpaṃ vā nidrājñānaṃ tathāpi vā| ālambate yadā cittaṃ sthairyaṃ samaśnute || 67 || svapne pūrvavāsanāprāptasattvapradhānaṃ manaḥ bhagavato yadrūpaṃ prabuddhaṃ evaṃ nidrādau yatsukhamanubhūyate tadālambanaṃ cittaṃ kṛtvā sthairyaṃ prāpnuyāt| ayamapi vāsanāyogasyāvāntarabheda iti candrikā | yadevālambate cittaṃ guṇavaiṣamyadūṣitam| dhyāyedetadananyassan cittaṃ tenāpi rudhyate || 68 || dhyānayoga iti yogaprakāro'yaṃ kathyate| yathābhimatānāṃ yathābhimateṣu dhyānamiti yogasiddhāntacandrikā | vaśīkāraṃ samāpnoti yogavit‌sthūlasūkṣmayoḥ| [paramaṃ tanmahāt‌sthūle sūkṣme cāparamāṇu tat] || 69 || yogino hi cittaṃ sūkṣme niviśamānaṃ paramāṇvantaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhathe sthūle ca mahāparimāṇe| ayaṃ siddhiyogaḥ| sphaṭikasya yathopādhessānnidhyādrūpadhāraṇam| tathā grāh‌yoparaktasya manaso rupadhāraṇam || 70 || nirmalasya sphaṭikasya yathā japākusumādyupādhisānnidhyāt raktādyākāratā tathaiva manasaḥ grāhyādyākāratā| puruṣendriyabhūteṣu kramaśo manasaḥ sthitiḥ| tattadākārasamprāptissamāpattiritīryate || 71 || śabdārthadhīvikalpaiśca sutarāṃ bhinnarupibhiḥ| saṃkīrṇā sā samāpattissavitarketi kathyate || 72 || śabdadharmā udāttādyāḥ jāḍ‌yādayo'rthavartinaḥ | prakāśo mūrtirahityañcetyanye jñānavartinaḥ || 73 || vaividhye vartamāne'pi caikattvameva sarvaśaḥ| bhajante ca tathā sarve śabdārthajñānarupiṇaḥ || 74 || gorityukte śabdārthajñānāni parasparamabhinnāni loke bhāsante| gauriti śabdaḥ, gaurityarthaḥ, gauritijñānaṃ - iti teṣāṃ bhinnatāya dharmeṣu bhinnattvāt| avidyāleśasaṃbandhadidamaparaṃ pratyakṣam| smṛtervipariśuddhau yā vastumātraiva bhāsate| nirvirketi nāmnā sā samāpattirnigadyate || 75|| śūnyattvaṃ bhāsate tasyāṃ svarupasya na śūnyatā| nirvikalpastathā cārthastasyāṃ nirbhāsate bhṛśam || 76 || tathaiva bhūtasūkṣmeṣu samāpattiśca tādṛśī| savicāreti vikhyātā viṣayassūkṣma eva saḥ || 77 || śāntādidharmaśūnyā yā yā sūkṣmaviṣayā tathā| nirvicārā samāpattisturīyā cottamā matā || 78 || saṅketasmṛtityāge sati yatrāvikalpitārthanirbhāsassā nirvitarkasamāpattiḥ| tanmātrāhaṅkārādiṣu sukṣmeṣu vikalpiteṣu samāpattissavicārā| teṣveva viśeṣamaśūnyeṣu arthamātreṣu samāpattirnirvicārā| samprajñātasya layayoga iti nāmāntaraṃ siddhāntacandrikāyāṃ dṛśyate| tat sūkṣmaviṣayattvañca pradhānāntaṃ prakathyate| na tvaliṅgāt paraṃ kiñcit sarvatattveṣu vidyate || 79 || sabījo'yaṃ samādhissyāt savitarkādibhūmibhiḥ| bījasyāto hyavidyā syāt samprajñātaśca tadyutaḥ || 80 || aśud‌dhyādimalāpetaṃ buddhisattvaṃ prakāśate| yadā, tadā samādhissyānnirvicāra itīritaḥ || 81 || ādhyātmikaḥ prasādassyātprajñālokastadā sphuṭaḥ | ṛtambharā tadā prajñā satyaṃ nityaṃ birbharta yā || 82 || yataḥ prajñā viśeṣārthā yatassūkṣmaṃ bibharti sā| śrutānumānabodhābhyāṃ tato vaividhyamaśnute || 83 || nirudhyante'nyasaṃskārāḥ prajñāsaṃskāravāriṇā | tatsaṃskāranirodhe syānnirbojo yoga iṣṭadaḥ || 84 || duḥkhabījairyataśśūnyastato nirbojanāmakaḥ | samādhirmokṣaheturhi yasminvai kevalaḥ pumān || 85 || savitarkādibhedavānasamprajñātasamādhiravidyārupabījasattvāt `sabījasamādhiḥ' tacchūnyastvasamprajñātasamādhi `nirboja samādhiḥ' | sabījasamādhau yadā nirvicāro viśāradībhavati tadā sattvodreko bhavati tasmin sati ṛtambhārā prajñā jāyate| samādhiprajñājanyasaṃskāreṇa vyutthānasaṃskārā bādhyante| tasyāpi saṃskārasya nirodhe nirboḍajassamādhistato mokṣa iti kramo jñeyaḥ| praṇavādipavitrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ japapūrvakam| yasya vai yāvatī śaktistāvatyā tapa ācaret || 83 || kriyāṇāṃ phalayuktānāṃ sarvāsāmapi cārpaṇam| sarvottame pare puṃsi kriyāyoga itīryate || 84 || samādhirbhāvanārūpaḥ kleśānāṃ śaktināśanam| kriyāyogena sid‌dhyete prasaṃkhyānāgnidāyake || 85 || avidyā tālmikā rāgaḥ dveṣaścābhiniveśanam| pañcaite kathitā yoge kleśāḥ pratyūhakārakāḥ || 86 || avidyāmāśritāssarve kleśā bījāmivāṅkurāḥ| avidyayaiva virdhante kṣīyante cāpyavidyayā || 87 || sad‌rūpā na tvabhāvo'sau mithyābuddhisvarūpiṇī| nitarāmapyasad‌dravye sadbuddhirjāyate tayā || 88 || tapassvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānarūpakriyāyogena samādhiprāptiḥ kleśānāmavidyādīnāṃ nāśaśca sambhavataḥ| yathāṅkuro bījāśrito vardhate tathaiva catvāraḥ kleśā avidyāśritāya vardhante tayaiva ca kṣīyante | avidyā ca na jñānābhāvaḥ vibhinnakāryajananasāmarthyavattvājjñānameva| puruṣasya tathā buddheratyantaṃ suvibhaktyoḥ| madhye caikātmikā buddhirasmitetyabhidhīyate || 89 || atyantaṃ bhinnayoḥ buddhipuruṣayormadhye h‌yabhinnattvadhīrasmiteti kathyate | sukhe tatsādhane gardho rāga ityābhidhīyate| duḥkhe tatsādhane manyurdveṣa ityabhidhīyate || 90 || `sukhe tatsādhane vā gardhastruṣṇā lobha sa rāga' iti bhāṣyavacanaṃ, `dṛśyamānamapi hi sukhasādhanaṃ tajjātīyasya sukhahetutāṃ smṛtvā tajjātīyatayā vāsya sukhahetutvamanumāyecchati| iti miśravacanamapi viṣaye'sminnanusandhātavyam|' viduṣo'pi sadā'saktirjovane vartate khalu| abhiniveśa ityeṣaḥ kleśastatrasti kāraṇam || 91 || kleśo'yaṃ svarasavāhī svabhāvena vāsanārūpeṇa vahanaśīlo na tvāgantukaḥ| mā'hamabhāvī bhūvaṃ sadā jīvyāsamiti pūrvajanmīyamaraṇaduḥkhānubhavahetukaḥ maraṇabhayarupaḥ kleśaḥ `abhiniveśaḥ' paṇḍitasyāpyasti| cittasya vilayenaite heyāḥ kleśāśca cittajāḥ| kleśānāṃ vṛttayaḥ sthūlāḥ heyā dhyainena yoginā || 92 || kleśe satyeva vartate dharmādharmai hi jīvane | vedanīyau yathā dṛṣṭe tathā'dṛṣṭe ca janmani || 93 || sukhaduḥkhe tayorjāte vipākastrividhastayoḥ| kleśamūlo vipāko'yaṃ jātyādirjīvane sadā || 94 || jātirāyuśca bhogaśca vipākastrividho mataḥ| ekadehabhādeṣo nanvekabhaviko mataḥ || 95 || avidyādipañcakleśebhyaḥ dharmādharmarupasaṃskāro vartamānabhaviṣyatkālayorbhogyo bhavati| dharmādhramayoreva sukhaduḥkhaphalaṃ jātyādivipākaśca| janma, jīvanakāle, bhoga iti trayaṃ vipāka iti kathyate| ekasminneva dehe phalasya bhāvo'stīti sa ekabhavikaḥ candrikāyāṃ vivṛtaḥ | viṣayabhogagardhasya vṛddhiryā dṛśyate nṛṣu| pariṇāmo hi sā proktā jñeyo'sau duḥkhadāyanī || 96 || tāpastu dveṣa evāsau bhogasya paripanthini| bhogasya smṛtihetussyāt saṃskāro duḥkadāyinī || 97 || tribharvā kāraṇairebhirguṇavaiṣamyakāraṇāt| bhuñjato viṣayān sarvān sarvaṃ duḥkham vivekinaḥ || 98 || apabhogena cātīṃta duḥkhaṃ sādhvativāhitam| vartamānaṃ tu bhogyaṃ tad duḥkhaṃ heyatvavarjitam || 99 || anāgataṃ yato duḥkhaṃ bādhate yoginaṃ bhṛśam | atastaddheyatāmeti yoginastattvamicchataḥ || 100 || puruṣasya tathā buddhessaṃyogo heyakāraṇam| niṣkriyassan dṛśyaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhogamokṣayoḥ || 101 || sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva jñānavyāpāramohadāḥ| bhūtendriyātmakaṃ dṛśyaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhogamokṣayoḥ || 102 || śabdādiviṣayākārā tadrūpaniścayātmikā || buddhivṛttirbhaved bhogo baddhavattena pūruṣaḥ || 103 || bhoktussvarūpavijñānaṃ mokṣa ityeva darśanam| bhogamokṣau na puṃsastau guṇanāmeva kevalam || 104 || draṣṭā'sau dṛśimātro'pi śuddhaṃ pratyayamīśrate | buddhivṛttivisaṃvedāt pariṇāmīva bhāsate || 105 || kāryakāraṇarūpaṃ tad‌dṛśyaṃ svārthaṃ kadā'pi na | samīhastu yathā'nyebhyastathā dṛśyaṃ parāya vai || 106 || kṛtārthaṃ prati naṣṭaṃ tannanaṣṭaṃ mūḍhacakṣuṣe| naśerdhānetorna lopo'rtho nāśo bhūyādadarśanam || 107 || dṛśyasyāsyopalabdhiryā sā bhoganāmikā matā | draṣṭussvarūpalabdhiśca mokṣassyādyogadarśane || 108 || citeścittasya saṃyoge tvavidyā kāraṇaṃ matam| avidyā sā yadā naṣṭā saṃyogo'pi tathā gataḥ || 109 || saṃyogasya hyabhāvo'sau hānamityatyute budhaiḥ| kaivalye kevalo jīvo guṇa vā kevalāstathā || 110 || hānaprāpterupāyo hi vivekakhyātināmakaḥ| mithyājñānavinirmuktā khyātissā mokṣakāraṇam || 111|| dṛśyaṃ nāma bhūtendriyātmakaṃ, draṣṭā nāma caitanyam| dṛśyasānnidhyavaśāt puruṣaḥ pariṇāmīva, puruṣasānnidhyavaśāt dṛśyaṃ caitnayamiva ca bhāsete| sānnidhyamathavā saṃyoga eva heyakāraṇam| yathā samyagalaṅkṛtāni vastūni tadirabhogāya tathā ca dṛśyaṃ puruṣadarśanārthaṃ pravartate| muktasya avidyā adṛṣṭā bhavati na tu sarveṣām| avidyāhetukasaṃyogasyāsyābhāvo hānam| tatprāptimārgastu viveka jñānam | tadvito yoginaḥ prajñā suptadhā jāyate'malā| prajñāṃ saptavidhāṃ prāpya yogī kaivalyamaśnute || 112 || 1. jñātavyamakhilaṃ jñātaṃ, na kiñcidapi jñātavyamasti - ityekā| 2. hātavyāssarve hitāḥ na kiñcidapi hātavyamasti - iti dvitīyā| 3. prāptavyamakhilaṃ prāptaṃ na kiñcanme prāptavyamasti - iti tṛtīyā| 4. kartavyamakhilaṃ kṛtaṃ na kiñcanme kartavyamasti - iti caturtho| 5. kṛtārthaṃ buddhitatvam - iti pañcamī| 6. guṇāḥ kṛtādhikārā - iti ṣaṣṭhī 7. guṇātīto'haṃ svarupamātrāvasthitaḥ saccidekarasaḥ iti saptamī | yogino lakṣyasaṃsiddhissādhanaṃ hi samāśritā| yogāṅgānāmanuṣṭhānaṃ sādhanaṃ cittanigrahe || 113 || yogāṅgānāmanuṣṭhānādaśuddhirnāśyate dhruvam | aśuddheśca kṣaye nūnaṃ viveko rājate mahān || 114 || yamāśca niyamāścaiva hyāsanam śraddhayā kṛtam | prāṇāyāmaśca tattvena pratyāhārastathaiva ca || 115 || dhāraṇādhyānayogāśca yogāṅgāni pṛthagvidhāḥ| te na kenā'pyavacchinnā sārvabhaumā mahāvratam || 116 || ahiṃsā sarvabhūteṣu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ| sarvatra sarvadā caiva tvanuṣṭheyā mumukṣubhiḥ || 117 || tatsāpekṣaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ saptakañcottarottaram | yogāṅganāmanuṣṭhānaṃ tato mukhyaṃ mumukṣauṇaḥ || 118 || nissarantī vahiśśaktiryogaṅgairgṛhyate yadā| tadā saṃvardhate satyaṃ daihikaṃ mānasaṃ balam || 119 || 1. ahiṃsā, satyaṃ, asteyaṃ, brahmacaryaṃ, aparigrahaḥ - yamāḥ 2. śaucaṃ santoṣaḥ, tapaḥ, svādhyāyaḥ, īśvarapraṇadhānam - niyamāḥ 3. padmaśvastikādīni - āsanāni 4. śaavāsapraśvāsayoḥ gativicchedaḥ - prāṇāyāmaḥ 5. indriyāṇāṃ cittasvarūpānukāraḥ pratyāhāraḥ 6. cittasya vividhapradeśeṣu sthāpanaṃ - dhāraṇā 7. ekarūpavṛttipravāhaḥ dhyānaṃ 8. dhyeyasyāsandigdhasarvātmanā bhānaṃ - samādhiḥ yamāstu jātideśakālasamayairanavacchinnā mahavratamityucyate| teṣāṃ samyaganuṣṭhānāt siddhyante bhinnaśaktayaḥ| ahiṃsāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ nivaireṇa syavasthitiḥ || 120 || satyasyaiva pratiṣṭhāyāṃ hyameghā jāyate sa vāk| upasthānaṃ ca ratnānāmasteyādeva siddhyayati || 121 || brahmacaryapratiṣṭhyāṃ yogī samārthyamaśnute | parigrahe parityakte jānāti janmanaḥ sthitim || 122 || śaucāt svāṅge, jugupsā syādasaṃsargastathā paraiḥ| santoṣāt sukhasaṃprāptiryasyā nāstyeva tolanam || 123 || tapo nāśayate'śuddhiṃ śraddhayā samyagāhitam| kāyendrimajayaṃ yogī tasmādāpnoti helayā || 124 || svādhyāyādiṣṭadevānāṃ sākṣātkāraśca siddhyati| devatā ṛṣayo divyā vartante yogikarmaṇi || 125 || sthiraṃ sukhakaraṃ yattat gṛh‌yatāṃ samyagāsanam| prayatnoparamāccite, sthire cittasya dhāraṇāt || 126 || na śītoṣṇādibhirdvandvairāsanajño'bhibhūyate| jittvā tatprathamaṃ vāyornigrahe yatnavān bhavet || 127 || bāhyasya grahaṇaṃ vāyornāsā pūrakamucyate | virocanaṃ tatastasya vidhivadrecakābhidham || 128 || tayostu gativicchedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| pūrakaḥ recakaḥ kumbha ityeṣaḥ kathikastridhā || 129 || dīrghasūkṣmassuvikhyātaścaturthaḥ kevalo mataḥ | śvāsapraśaavāsaśūnyo hi prāṇo bhati kevale || 130 || prāṇāyāmātprakāśasya prāvāraḥ kṣīyate dhruvam | dhāraṇārthaṃ tadā yogyaṃ śuddaṃ saṃjāyate manaḥ || 131 || nābhicakrādideśeṣu bandhaścittasya dhāraṇā| dhyānaṃ vṛttipravāhassyāt samānaśca nirantaraḥ || 132 || dhyeyākāravinirbhāsaṃ dhyānaṃ samādhisaṃjñakam| na rūpam vastutaśśūnyaṃ samādhau pratyayātmake || 133 || bandhadhyānasamādhīnāṃ saṃjñā yoge tu saṃyamaḥ| saṃyamasyaiva saṃsid‌dhyā prajñādīpaḥ prakāśate || 134 || ekaikasyāstathā bhūmerjayenānyagāmitā | manasaḥ siddhyate nūnaṃ tena prajñā pradīpyate || 135 || antaraṅgaṃ trayaṃ cedaṃ samādhessādhanāt param| nirbojasyāpi yogasya bahiraṅgaṃ trayaṃsmṛtam || 136 || yogasandarbhe saṃyamo nāma dhāraṇā, dhyānaṃ samādhiśca trayam| ekasmin vastuni pratyayāntarahitaṃ citaṃ samānapratyayapravāhavat sadarthamātranirbhāsaṃ yadā bhavati tadā saṃyamaḥ jñeyaḥ| etādṛśī manasaśśaktirekāgratarūpā sampādanīyā| yamādipañcabhyaḥ dhāraṇādhyānasamādhayo'ntaraṅgam| sākṣāt svarūpopakārakaṃ trayam| nirbojasya samādhestu sākṣādahetuttvāt bahiraṅgam| pariṇāmastridhā proktaścittasyāsthiravartinaḥ | nirodhaśca samādhiśca tathācaikāgratābhidhaḥ || 137 || vyutthānābhibhavassamyak nirodhasya samud‌bhavaḥ| saskārasya gatiścitrā nirodha iti kathyate || 138 || samādhipariṇāmassyāt dvayormānasadharmayoḥ| sarvārthatākṣayassamyagekāgratvodayastathā || 139 || śāntoditau punardharmau samānapratyayau yadā | jñeya ekāgratārūpaḥ pariṇāmaścittadharmiṇaḥ || 140 || kṣiptamūḍhavikṣiptākhyaṃ bhūmitrayaṃ vyutthānam| tatra kṣiptaṃ rajoguṇodrekādasthiraṃ, mūḍhaṃ tamogumodrekavat, vikṣiptaṃ sattvodrekādrajoviśiṣṭaṃ duḥkhasādhanaṃ parihṛtya sukhasādhaneṣveva śabdādiṣu pravṛttaṃ cittam| vyutthānasaṃskārabhibhavo nāma kṣiptiditrayasya dāhaḥ| nirodhasaṃskārasamud‌bhavo nāma prakaṭatayā vartamānādhvani samavasthitiḥ| nirodhakālīnaḥ pariṇāmaścitaṃ sthiraṃ karotīti sampādanīyo bhavati| ayaṃ nirodhapariṇāmaḥ| cittasya sarvarthatāyā kṣayaḥ, ekāgratāyāḥ udayaśca samādhipariṇāma| tatra dvāvatītotpadyamānau sadṛśapratyayau `ekāgratapariṇāmo' bhavati| sajātīyapratyasyaikaikasya nāśe sati pratyayāntaraṃ sajītīṃ cotpadyate| vyākhyātāstvanaiva dharmā bhūtendriyeṣu ca| ekadharmaparityāge prāptirdharmāntarasya ca| prathamaḥ pariṇāmassyāt dharmiṇo sthūlarūpiṇaḥ || 141 || dharmāṇāñcāpyatītādikālabhedena bhinnatā| lakṣaṇākhyo dvitīyassyāt pariṇāmo hi tattvataḥ || 142 || gavādorbālyakaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ vārdhakaṃ tathā | avasthākhyasatṛtīyassyāt pariṇāmassa cāntimaḥ || 143 || ekasya dharmiṇaḥ pūrvadharminivṛttau dharmāntaraprāptardharmapariṇāmaḥ| yathā mṛdaḥ piṇḍabhāvatyāgena ghaṭabhāvaḥ| vartamānāvasthāyā atītāvarasthāprāptirūpaḥ kālabhedena bhedasampādako lakṣaṇapariṇāmaḥ| pracīnatvārvācīnatvādibhedarupaḥ avasthāpapariṇāmaḥ| trayo vai dharmiṇo dharmāḥ dharmo dharmiṣu yogyatā| vyāpāraśritadharmasya traividhyaṃ sūtrakṛnmatam || 144 || atītā vartamānaśca dharmāścānāgatastathā | vartate teṣu sarveṣu tadbhinno dharmavān sadā || 145 || kramo yo yasya dharmasya samanantatāvahaḥ | pariṇāme kramo nityaṃ nānātvasyāsti kāraṇam || 146 || pariṇāmatraye yogī saṃyamājjñānavān bhavet| atītānāgatasyāpi sarvasyaiva hi vastutaḥ || 147 || śabdārthapratyayānāṃ hi saṃkaro'ghyāsamūlakaḥ | sarvabhūtarutaṃ jñānaṃ tadvibhāgasya saṃyamāt || 148 || saṃskārā dvividhāḥ proktā vāsanā āśyāstathā | vāsanā syāt smṛterheturvipākasyaiva cāśayāḥ || 149 || sākṣātkārāttathaiteṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ hi tattvataḥ| jñānaṃ svasya parasyāpi jāyate pūrvajanmanaḥ || 150 || pratyaye saṃyamāt jñānaṃ paricittasya jāyate| na tatsālambanaṃ proktaṃ svacittāviyīkṛteḥ || 151 || yogītā tāṃ grāhyatāśaktiṃ pratiṣṭabhnāti saṃyamāt| tanmātrāṇāmatastasyāṃ hyantardhānaṃ prajāyate || 152 || vipāko'pyāyuṣaḥ karma dvividhaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ| sopakramaṃ tadādyaṃ syāddvivatīyaṃ nirupakramam || 153 || phaladaṃ tīvravegena sopakramitīryate | karma tanmandavegena nirupakramamucyate || 154 || dvayostu saṃyamādyogī jñānamāpadyate mahat| ariṣṭabhyastathā vetti mṛtyorāgamanaṃ tathā || 155 || bhāvanāsaṃyamādhyogī hastyadiṣvapi saṃyamāt| anuttamaṃ tathā śīghraṃ tattadāpadyate balam || 156|| jyotiṣmattyā pravṛttyā ca prakāśanyāsataśca dhīḥ| sūkṣmasya viprakṛṣṭasya vyavahitasya jāyate || 157 || sūrye ca saṃyamājjñānaṃ bhuvanasyāpi jāyate | tārāvyūhagadijñāne śaśāṅkadhruvasaṃyamāt || 158 || kāvyahasya saṃbodho nābhicakre ca saṃyamāt | kṣutpipāsāvinaśaśca kaṇṭhakūpe ca saṃyamāt || 159 || saṃyamāt kūrmanāṅyāṃ ca saṃyamī vartate sthiraḥ | suṣumnāyāṃ tathā kṛtvā siddhānanvīkṣate hi saḥ || 160 || prātibhe saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā sarvaṃ jānāti helayā | hṛdaye ca tathā kṛtvā cittaṃ jānāti saṃyamī || 161 || atyantaṃ tāvasaṃkīrṇo prakṛtiḥ puruṣassadā | bhogastadbhedaśūnyatvaṃ parārthattvācca tattvataḥ || 162 || parārthaṃ taṃ suvijñāyā svārathe kṛtvā ca saṃyamam| puruṣaṃ vetti taṃ yogī vijñātārañca helayā || 163 || puruṣe saṃyamādyogī beh‌vīssiddhīssamaśnute| prātibhaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ jñānaṃ vedanākhyaṃ tathaiva ca || 164 || ādarśasvādavārtāśca siddhayastāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ| indriyaṃ viṣayaṃ divyaṃ gṛhṇātītyeva siddhayaḥ || 165 || antarāyāśca yoge te prātibhādyāstu siddhyaḥ | vyutthāne siddhyastāstu tasmāttyājyā mumukṣubhiḥ || 166 || karmabandhakṣayādyogī cittasancāravedanāt | anyadeheṣu cittaṃ taddhelayā saṃvaṃ kṣipatyatha || 167 || udānasya jāyatpaṅke jale vā kaṇṭakādiṣu| utkrāntiṃ labhate yogī tadvāyoścaiva śaktitaḥ || 168 || samānasya jāyadyogī jvalatyagnivadeva vā | ākāśassarvaśabdānāṃ pratiṣṭhā śabdavāridheḥ || 169 || sambandhe saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā tvākāśakarṇayostathā | divyaṃ śrotraṃ samādatte yogī śabdasya kāraṇam || 170 || laghutūlasamāpatterākāśe ḍayate tathā | śarīrakāśasaṃbandhe yogī kṛtvā ca saṃyamam || 171 || sthūlasvarūpasūkṣmeṣu tathānvayārthavattvayoḥ| saṃyamāt pañcabhūtānāṃ saṃyamī jayamaśnute || 172 || siddīnāmaṇimādyānāṃ prāptistenaiva siddhyate | kāyasampat‌ samāptiśca dharmaiścānabhibhūtatā || 173 || grahaṇañca svarūpañca tathaiva cāsmitānvayaḥ | eteṣu saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā saṃyamī jayatīndriyam || 174 || buddhipuruṣayorbhedaṃ samyagvijñāya saṃyamī| sarvajñassarvabhāvānāmadhiṣṭhātā ca vai bhavet || 176 || tad‌vairāgyādaśeṣāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ bījanāśataḥ| kaivalyaṃ labhate draṣṭā svarūpavasthitiṃ dhruvam || 177|| tattad‌bhogarasāsvāde devaiścopanimantritaḥ| saṅgasmayau na vai guryādyogī punaraniṣṭataḥ || 178 || kṣaṇatatkramayoryogī saṃyamāllabhate'cirāt| jñānaṃ vivekasampannaṃ tārakaṃ sarvasaṃkṣayāt || 179 || śuddhisāmye hi kaivalyaṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca | sattvādhikārasambūrtidraṣṭussvarūpadarśanāt || 180 || janmanaścauṣadheścaiva mantrācca tapasastathā| samādheśca prasiddhyanti siddhyaḥ pañcathā hi tāḥ || 181 || mānavādiśarīrebhyastad‌ bhinnadeharūpatā | prakṛtyāpūrato jñeyā dharmādharmānimittikā || 182 || dharmādyā nimittaṃ te na kadāpi prayojakāḥ | kāryaṃ prāvārabhedena kṣetriko'tra nidarśanam || 183 || kāyāntaraṃ yadā yogī nirmimīte svaśaktitaḥ| tatra nirmāṇacittāni kevalāhaṃkṛtestadā || 184 || vyāpārasya hi nānātve cittamekaṃ prayojakam | tatrāpi dhyānajaṃ cittaṃ karmaśayavivarjitam || 185 || sāmānyatastu sampūrṇā karmājitaścuṣpadī| śuklā puṇyātmanāmeva kṛṣṇā tāvadadurātmanām || 186 || śuklakṛṣṇā pareṣāṃ sā yogināṃ tu kadāpi na | tadrūpaśca vipākassyāttattajjātīyakarmaṇaḥ || 187 || abhivyaktā vipākena tadrūpāścaiva vāsanāḥ | devatiryaṅmanuṣyeoṣu samānaścarca eva saḥ || 188 || smṛtisaṃskārayoraikyaṃ rupe tāvad yataḥ sthitam| ato jātyādibhiliṅgairvyavahito'pyanantaraḥ || 189 || kṛṣīvalo yathā kedārāt kedārāntaraṃ jalaṃ ninīṣuḥ prativandhāvaraṇabhedamātraṃ karoti tathaiva dharmādi nimittaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ pariṇāmena prayojakam| yogino'haṅkārādutpanneṣu citteṣu vyāpāranānātve yiganaḥ cittamekameva prayojakam| janmādipañcavidhacittedhyānajaṃ cittameva vāsanārahitam| caturvidhāyāṃ karmajātyāṃ śukla, kṛṣṇa, śuklakṛṣma aśuklakṛṣṇarūpāyāṃ caturthī yoganāṃ, yasya yādṛśaṃ karma tadanuguṇameva phalam tasya| punastatphalānuguṇavāsanānāmabhivyaktiḥ sarveṣu| saṃskārāt smṛtiḥ, smṛteśca bhogaḥ, yogānubhavācya punaḥ saṃskārasmṛtyādayaḥ - ataḥ janmaśatena, dūradeśatayā, kalpaśatena vā vyavahitānāmapi vāsānānāṃ avyavahitavat kāryakāritvaṃ bhati - iti bhāvaḥ| vāsanānāmanāditvaṃ nityatvādāśiṣastathā| cittaṃ tad‌vāsanāviddhaṃ citerbhogāya kalpate || 190 || hetuphalāśrayālāmbaissaṅgṛhītāstu vāsanāḥ| hetvādīnāmabhāve tā vināśaṃ yānti sarvathā || 191 || vāsanā na kevalaṃ vyavathānarahitā api cādiśūnyāḥ| vāsanastāḥ hetvādīnālambya pravartante| tatra hetuḥ sākṣātparamparayā vā - avidyā, phalaṃ śarīrādi smṛtyādi ca , āśyaścittaṃ, ālambanaṃ yadevālambanamanubhavasya tadeva vāsanānāmapīti jñeyam| eṣāmabhāve vāsanānāmapyabhāvaḥ| vāsanāśca nivarteran kathaṃ dravyattvasambhave| ityevaṃ vāsanānāśe saṃdih‌yātpuruṣaḥ kvacit || 192 || atītānagatāḥ dharmāścittaṃ dharmi svarūpataḥ| dharmāṇāmeva bedo'yaṃ dharmi bhedavivarjitam || 193 || tryadhvāno khalvamī dharmā vyaktasūkṣmāśca tattvataḥ | guṇānāṃ tanniveśātte guṇātmāno bhavanti ca || 194 || vyaktāstu vartamānāste dharmā, bhūtendriyeṣu ca| atītānāgatāssūkṣmāḥ dharmā bhūtādigocarāḥ || 195 || aṅgāṅgibhāvatastattvaṃ guṇānāmekamiṣyate| pariṇāmo bahūnāṃ hi tailādīnāṃ pradīpavat || 196 || triṣvapi guṇeṣu kvacit sat‌tavamaṅgi kvacidrajaḥ kvacicca tama iti guṇānāmaṅgāṅgibhāvo'sti| yadyapi trayo guṇāḥ tathā'pi teṣāmaṅgiṅgitvāt vastunamatvamekatvam| yathā tailavastivahnīnāmekaḥ pradīpapariṇāmastathā'yam| dṛṣṭaṃ bahuvidhaṃ jñānaṃ vastunyekavidhe tathā| ato jñānārthayorbhinnaḥ panthā ityeva niścayaḥ || 197 || ekasyāṃ rūpalāvanyavatyāṃ yoṣiti rāgiṇassukhaṃ, sapatnyāstu dveṣaḥ, vedāntinastūdāsīnatā, parivrājakasya ghṛṇā - ityekavastuni bhinnapratyayaḥ dṛśyate| ataḥ jñānaṃ viṣayād bhinnam| cittanāśe pramāṇaṃ na cittasyātaḥ svatantratā| jñānasahabhuvaṃ cetthamartham sūtre nirasyati || 198 || jñānādatirikto'rtha iti bhavatu, tathāpi jñānenaiva bhāsyatvāt sukhādivad bhogyatvāt jñānasahabhūrevārtha iti matasamīcīnamiti vadati| sarvajanasamānaḥ svatantro'rthaḥ, pratipuruṣaṃ pravartamānāni cittāni svatantrāṇi| ayovad viṣayemaitaduparaktañca mānasam| tamādatte jahātyanyamaṃ jñātājñātāstathā hi saḥ || 199 || cittavṛttissadā jñātā puṃsassā kūṭavartinaḥ| pariṇami yataścittaṃ pumām̐statsaṃvivarjitaḥ || 200|| svābhāsaṃ na kadāpyetat dṛśyatvāccittamagnivat| na hrayagnistamasā gūḍhaḥ pūrva prakāśate || 201 || agnivat vṛttaya eva svaprakāśā bhaveyuḥ kiṃ vṛttisaṃvedinā puruṣeṇeti cet - na ; yataścittaṃ pariṇāmi nīlādivadatastat svābhāsaṃ na bhavati kintu svavyatiriktadraṣṭrāpekṣam| cittasya tu prakāśāprakāśādidharmavattvāt guṇavaiṣamyakāraṇena vahnyādidṛṣṭāntamapyatra na saṅgacchata iti bhāvaḥ || svarūpārthau yatiścittaṃ nādatte dvayamekadā| svābhāsaṃ tatastanna kevalaṃ dṛśyamiṣyate || 202 || vṛttyantareṇa grāh‌yatve vṛtteratiprasaṅgāt | anantavṛttibodhe syādananantasmṛtisaṃkaraḥ || 203 || caitanyaṃ tadasaṃkīrṇaṃ svabuddhivṛttivedanam | buddhivṛttisvarūpe tu tadrūpaṃ jāyate punaḥ || 204 || mantavyārthoparaktaṃ tat sadviṣayañca mānasam | drūṣṭudṛśyoparaktaṃ hi cittaṃ svārthamucyate || 205 || cittaṃ saṃhatyakārittvāt parārthamiti kathyate | tadasaṃkhyeyasaṃskāraiścitritamapi gehavat || 206 || sattavapuruṣayorbhedaṃ jānāti saṃyamī ca yaḥ | vinivṛttā bhavatsay tadātmabhāvabhāvanā || 207 || viṣayaiḥ pūrṇamajñānāccittaṃ jñānodaye punaḥ| kaivalyābhimukhaṃ yāti vivekakhyātibhārataḥ || 208 || ye samādhyantarāleṣu jātāścetapratyayāḥ | jñeyā vyutthānasaṃskārairnāśayāścittavināśanāt || 209 || yathā kleśā na rohanti vahnau pradagdhabījavat| saṃskārāśca tathā pūrve jñānadagdhā vināśitāḥ || 210 || dharmamedhassamādhissyāt prasaṃkhyāne'pyarāgiṇaḥ | vivekakhyātito jñeyassamādhiḥ kleśanāśakaḥ || 211 || samprajñātaparākāṣṭhā nūnaṃ dharmasya varṣakaḥ | dharmamegho mahān yoge mārgaḥ kaivalyadāyakaḥ || 212 || tasya lābhādavidyādyāḥ lakleśāssarve'pi nāśitāḥ | karmāśayāśca sampūrṇaṃ te bhavanti vināśitāḥ || 213 || sarvakleśavinirmuktaṃ sarvadoṣavavarjitam | anantaṃ jāyate jñānaṃ jñeyamalpaṃ hi bhāsate || 214 || guṇānāṃ tu kṛtārthānāṃ samādherudayāttathā| samāptaḥ pariṇāmasya kramo bhogopayoginaḥ || 215 || vartamānā guṇānāñca sā pariṇāminityatā| kṛṭasthanityatatā puṃso jñeyā sā nityatā dvayoḥ || 216 || kṣaṇadvandvī kramo jñeyasya kṣaṇapracayāśrayaḥ| kramo'parāntanirgrāhyaḥ pariṇāmanasya tattvataḥ || 217 || samādherudayāt kṛtārthānāṃ guṇānāṃ bhogapayoginaḥ pariṇāmasya kramassamāpto bhavati| kramasya nirūpakaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tādṛśakṣaṇapracayāśra eva kramaḥ niṣkṛṣyāparāntena grāhyaḥ| mṛdi piṇḍaghaṭakapālacūrṇakāṇānāṃ pūrvāntaḥ piṇḍaḥ aparāntaḥ kaṇaḥ itīti yogasudhākaraḥ| puruṣārthe viniṣpanne tacchūnyo mohako guṇaḥ| pratiprasavamāvapannaḥ kevalo vidyate sadā || 218 || tadā bandhavinirmuktaḥ puruṣo nirguṇassadā| svarūpāvasthito yoge caitanyākhyastadā bhavet || 219 || bandhamokṣau na dehasya na vā puṃsaḥ kadācana| bandho'yaṃ cittarāgassyānamokṣassyādavirāgitā || 220 || pātañjalaṃ mahatsūtraṃ vyāsabhāṣyakaraṃ tathā| vācaspatestathānyeṣāṃ vākyañcalāmbya tattvataḥ || ślokeṣu yogasūtrāṇāṃ nibandho'yaṃ kṛto mayā| ahaṃ tu karaṇaṃ cāsmin kāraṇaṃ gurvanugrahaḥ ||
